description: This file defines a React functional component called Modal, which implements a themed modal dialog with backdrop, animations, accessibility features, and keyboard interaction (Escape key to close). It also includes type annotations for props and manages event listeners for keyboard events.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal dialog with customizable size, header, footer, and content. Handles backdrop clicks, escape key presses, and manages document body scroll behavior when open.
